name: Adversarial review (+ by-construction follow-up)
reviewers_detail: phase 1: A policy/documents, B channels/lifecycle, C strict mode/files (partial); phase 2 verification by reproduction, no separate verifiers
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings, many split ('medium/high', 'low/medium'). Counts use the FIRST-listed rating. Worst-half counts: high 1 (A1), medium 8, low 8, info 4 (+2 unrated). Research 18 counts 'medium in either half' = 9. The 2 unrated are the follow-up's 'two new gaps' (S26), which carry no severity.
effect_basis: DERIVED by me from the finding text (report does not classify). Data = A1, A2, B1, B2, C2, C5; availability = B3, B7. The 2 follow-up gaps and 13 candidates have no data effect.
strict_basis: Strict was opt-in at this commit and typed `origins` did not exist yet, so 'strict default / origins' is n/a as defined. Findings that apply to strict mode: A1, C2, C5. A2 is iframe mode; B1 and B2 are the iframe/worker-mode bootstraps (strict not stated).
class_basis: Research 18 classes of the 9 medium-or-higher: G 3 (B1,B2,C2), C 2 (A1,A2), B 2 (A3,C1), E-cpu 1 (B3), L 1 (B4). The report's own letters A/B/C are reviewer AREAS, not classes.
notes: 21 candidates = 19 fixed, 1 held (A8), 1 documented (B8); the follow-up fixed C1/C4/C5 by construction and found 2 more gaps. Counts here include those 2 as unrated. Pre-dates strict-as-default (S48, 2026-10-15) and typed origins (S47).

name: Focused review (guest writes W, follow-up fixes F)
reviewers_detail: not stated: 'two focused adversarial rounds' (W = guest writes and files, F = the follow-up's fixes); reviewer count is not given
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings, single (no splits). The 1 unrated is the 'Hardening' item (sandbox:fetch bound per build).
effect_basis: DERIVED. Data = W1 (inert file ran as script), F1 (SMIL re-animated href, request left). Availability = W2 (rate windows), F2 (execution budget evaded). F4 was latent.
strict_basis: Both reproduced in strict mode (W1 in iframe, worker and strict; F1 in the strict view). Strict was opt-in then; origins/fetchBridge n/a.
class_basis: Research 18: W1 B, F1 B, F2 G (the 3 medium-or-higher).
notes: 11 findings + 1 hardening; 10 fixed, W5 documented, F4 latent.

name: Broad review (reviewers A, B, D) + strict mode (reviewer C)
reviewers_detail: A policy/documents, B channels/lifecycle, C strict mode, D the platform; no separate verifier (the next report, VR, is the independent verification)
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings, FIRST-listed where split (CB1 medium/low, CB4 info/low). Worst-half: high 2, medium 6, low 8, info 9. 'High' for PD1/PD2 is engine-specific (WebKit / Firefox). 21 findings by A, B, D + ST1-ST4 by C. The renderer-allowlist change is an unrated design change and is not counted. Report headline says '21 findings' + 4 for C.
effect_basis: DERIVED. Data: CB1, CB2, CB4, CB6, CB7, PD1, PD2, PD3, PD4, PD5, PD6, PD7, ST1 (CB4, CB6, PD7 are low-weight information/message leaks). Availability: CB3, ST2, ST3.
strict_basis: Only ST1 is stated for strict. PD2/PD4/PD5/PD6 are guest-document paths; the report says strict mode runs no guest script in a document and that those paths 'were not re-measured in strict mode'. The others do not say. Strict was opt-in.
class_basis: Research 18 of the 8 medium-or-higher: E-net 5 (PD1-PD5), G 1 (CB1), B 1 (ST1), P 1 (ST2).
notes: Also: the strict renderer became an allowlist (design change, unrated). Residual S42 (CSS paint cost in WebKit) opened. Appendix holds 3 upstream browser bug reports (PD1 WebKit, PD2 Firefox, V1 Firefox).

name: Independent verification
reviewers_detail: 5 verifiers: 2 mutation-efficacy, black box, claims-and-CI, decisions. They verified the three earlier reports and added new findings.
severity_basis: The report gives a severity only for V1 ('high on Firefox'). V3 medium and H1 low are the BD2 coordinator's ratings (BOARD-PASS-2 section 2.1), NOT the report's. Unrated: V2 (functional bug), WebKit clipboard residual, same-site cookie observation, and the 9 test gaps. 63 of 66 mutations were caught.
effect_basis: DERIVED. Data: V1 (EventSource/FontFace egress), V3 (modifier-click tab), H1 (tab history), clipboard (WebKit), same-site cookies observation. None-effect: V2 + 9 test gaps.
strict_basis: V1 is stated for strict and worker mode. V3: strict opens nothing. H1/clipboard are default (cooperative) document paths. The cookie observation is not tied to a mode.
class_basis: Research 18: V1 E-net (high), V3 E-net. Coordinator maps H1 and the cookie observation to A.
notes: Decisions taken after it: ready = guest check-in (S46), strict mode becomes the default and 'iframe' is renamed 'cooperative' (S48).

name: Review round 1 (stopping rule)
reviewers_detail: 5 launched, 4 completed (fuzzing Opus, spec conformance Sonnet, embedder Fable, real apps Sonnet); the black-box reviewer (Opus) was stopped by a safety classifier before any probe
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings, no verifier. 9 medium = 8 'ours' (this is the stopping-rule count) + R2-2 (platform / cooperative limit). Merged IDs counted once (R3-1=R2-1, R4-1=R2-3). Info = R1-5, R3-10, R3-11, R3-12, R4-9, R4-11. Unrated = R4-4, R4-5 (owner decisions).
effect_basis: DERIVED. Data: R2-2 (synthesized modifier click opens a tab; form past form-action, Chromium). Availability: R1-1, R1-2, R3-3 and the 'availability' claim row.
strict_basis: R2-2 is a cooperative-mode limit (strict links are inert). Strict mode is the default on this commit (S48), so 'strict at default' = 0 data findings.
class_basis: Research 18 of the 9 medium-or-higher: P 3 (R1-1, R1-2, availability), E-cpu 2 (R3-3, R4-2), B(L) 1 (R3-1), G 1 (R4-1), O 1 (R4-3), E-net 1 (R2-2). Coordinator: R3-1 is class A (policy container).
notes: Result 'not clean': 8 medium in our code. Stopping rule: two consecutive clean rounds. From this round on the findings come from the embedder side and from real content.

name: Review round 2
reviewers_detail: L model-based lifecycle (Opus), C audit of code changed since R1 (Sonnet), M documented limits at their edge (Opus)
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings, no verifier. L-5 (platform) and L-9 (platform) and L-8/M-4/M-6 (documented limits) are counted here (the report counts them apart from 'ours').
effect_basis: DERIVED. Availability: C-1, C-3, C-4, C-7, M-3, M-5. No finding has a data effect.
class_basis: Research 18 of the 10 medium-or-higher: G 2, P 2, L 2, C 2, B 1, O 1. Both highs (C-1, C-3) are in code added by round 1's fixes.
notes: Result 'not clean': 2 high + 8 medium in our code.

name: Review round 3
reviewers_detail: L model-based lifecycle (Opus), C audit (Sonnet), M limits (Opus)
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings. M-1 = L-3 is one finding. 'unsplit_low_or_info' = M-7, C-5, C-6, reported together as 'info, low' with no per-ID rating. M-3 (low) is a documented limit; M-6/M-8/M-9 (info) documented/platform.
effect_basis: DERIVED. Availability: C-1, M-1, C-2, M-2, C-4, M-5, M-3.
class_basis: Research 18 of the 8 medium-or-higher: P 3 (C-1, M-1, C-2), L 2, E-cpu 2, G 1.
notes: Result 'not clean'. M-1 (CSS animations defeat the time budget) was closed by an option, allowAnimations, default true at this commit. Research 16 established that the view shares the host thread on Firefox/WebKit.

name: Review round 4
reviewers_detail: L model-based lifecycle (Opus), C audit (Sonnet), M limits (Opus)
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings. 'unsplit_low_or_info' = M-3, C-3, C-4, I-1, I-2, reported together as 'low, info' (docs). First round with no high.
effect_basis: DERIVED. Availability: M-1, C-1, C-2, M-2, M-6.
class_basis: Research 18 of the 5 mediums: P 2 (C-2, M-2), E-cpu 1 (M-1), G 1 (C-1), L 1 (L-1).
notes: Result 'not clean'. 3 of 5 mediums are in code round 3 added; L-1 is an earlier fix that did not hold.

name: Review round 5
reviewers_detail: C audit (Sonnet), L model-based lifecycle (Opus), M limits (Opus)
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings. L-2 = N-5 one finding. Lows: N-2, N-3, N-4, L-3 and the 3-item row N-7 / L-2(M) / L-3(M). Info: L-4, N-6.
effect_basis: DERIVED. Availability: M-1, N-1, M-2, M-3, M-4, N-2. M-3 is labelled E-net/B by the report (CSS url() to an ALLOWED origin bypassed the URL budget), counted as availability because the destination is policy-permitted.
class_basis: Report letters of the 7 medium-or-higher: P 3 (M-1, M-2, M-4), E-cpu 1 (N-1), L 1 (L-1), C 1 (L-2), E-net/B 1 (M-3).
notes: Result 'not clean': 1 high + 6 medium. M-2 and M-3 were later changed (S72 repeated-overrun rule, S73 prepaid CSS loads). Research 18 was written during this round.

name: S74 review board, pass 1
reviewers_detail: ISO, CHL, LIM (Opus); DOC, TST (Sonnet); NEW (Haiku) + coordinator observations (CO-1); 3 Opus verifiers re-checked the highs (CHL-2, LIM-1..3, ISO-1)
severity_basis: As verified: LIM-3 raised medium to high; CHL-2, LIM-1, ISO-1 confirmed high. The report's headline says 'Low (31)'; that omits the 12 DOC lows (DOC-3..14) listed as one bullet: 31 + 12 = 43. Info = TST-10. Reviewer-level: high 3 + LIM-3 medium.
effect_basis: STATED for data: the report and BACKLOG S74 name BD1:ISO-1, NEW-1, NEW-14 as 'findings that leak data' (owner, 2026-10-21). The coordinator's table marks only ISO-1 and NEW-1 as leak (NEW-14, pointer lock, 'no'). Availability: CHL-2, LIM-1, LIM-2, LIM-3 (named DoS/availability by the owner decision) + NEW-6 (looping entry, documented). TST-1 (test gap on an availability fix) is counted as no-data-effect.
strict_basis: ISO-1 via fetchBridge (any mode) and NEW-1 via origins (Firefox, cooperative and strict-worker) reach strict with an opt-in. NEW-14 (pointer lock) is cooperative/worker only.
class_basis: Report letters of the 4 highs: P 2 (CHL-2, LIM-3), G/B 1 (LIM-1), E-net 1 (ISO-1). Coordinator root classes (all 53 not mapped): V 6, A 2, R 2, E 1, D ~22, C 4; the 3 DoS highs are all V, the data leaks A.
notes: Result: 4 confirmed high, 0 critical; not clean (0 of 2). Owner: fix only what leaks data now; DoS/availability go to backlog (S77-S82; S77 and S78 later fixed). Docs and test reviewers (DOC, TST) and the newcomer produce 33 of the 43 lows, so the low count is not comparable with rounds 1-5, which had no such reviewers.

name: S74 review board, pass 2
reviewers_detail: same six roles as pass 1 (ISO, CHL, LIM Opus; DOC, TST Sonnet; NEW Haiku); 3 verifiers (ISO-1/ISO-2 with NEW-2; CHL-1/CHL-2; NEW-1/NEW-4); the coordinator's class review of both passes is in the same file
severity_basis: As verified. Reviewer ratings were high 4 / medium 9 / low 16. Changes: ISO-1 high to medium; NEW-4 medium to low. ISO-2 is medium alone but 'high with NEW-2' (counted medium here; NEW-2 is the high). Unresolved in the report: DOC-3, TST-7.
effect_basis: STATED: 'Confirmed findings that leak or can manipulate data: NEW-1, ISO-2 with NEW-2, CHL-1, ISO-1' (NEW-2 and ISO-2 counted separately = 5). The coordinator's table marks CHL-1 as 'no leak' but the board counted it (an orphaned guest outlives terminate()). Availability only: CHL-2 (code half to S79), LIM-3 (to S82).
strict_basis: NEW-2 and ISO-2 (cookies on requests to listed origins) reach strict with the origins opt-in; ISO-1 (hash-admitted bootstrap as a gadget on the host page) is a strict-default precondition. NEW-1 (host base-uri) leaks only in cooperative mode (strict part rated low, no guest-readable leak); CHL-1 orphans a guest only in Firefox cooperative mode (strict: fail-closed corruption, medium).
class_basis: Coordinator root classes (P2 column): A 5, E 2, V 3, R 1, D ~12, C 1, B 1, E-net 1. Every data finding of both passes is class A or E (coordinator).
notes: Result: not clean (0 of 2). New rule (owner, 2026-10-21): a pass is clean when no confirmed finding leaks or can manipulate data at any severity; DoS/availability-only do not count; strict mode with origins and fetchBridge is the baseline.

name: S74 review board, pass 3 (not archived yet)
reviewers_detail: ISO, CHL, LIM, DOC, TST, NEW; 2 verifier verdicts so far (v3-chl1 for CHL-1; v3-iso for ISO-1 and ISO-2). TST report is present and complete (10 findings).
severity_basis: Reviewer ratings; CHL-1, ISO-1, ISO-2 verified high. LIM-1 is 'high by BD1:LIM-1's rating, medium by the rubric if the owner prefers' and has NO verdict (counted high). Mediums: DOC-1, NEW-1, NEW-2, NEW-7, TST-1, TST-2 (TST-1/TST-2 are test gaps: main is correct, probes pass). Pass-3 rubric (brief3): availability and docs-misleading are medium; high needs a documented property that does not hold.
effect_basis: STATED by the reviewers: data = ISO-1, ISO-2, CHL-1, NEW-7 (all reach strict) and DOC-1 (cooperative only). Availability-only = LIM-1. TST-1/TST-2 are labelled 'data (would be a leak if broken)' by the reviewer but the code is correct, so they are counted as no data effect; CHL-2 is 'data only if the embedder follows the docs' (docs gap, counted none).
strict_basis: STATED: ISO-1, ISO-2, CHL-1 (strict default + origins/fetchBridge, WebKit data leaves), NEW-7 (origins.images, Firefox; a documented residual, owner to classify). DOC-1 is cooperative only.
class_basis: Reviewer letters: ISO-1 B, ISO-2 B (both root class A: the host page's context), CHL-1 L (with C), LIM-1 P/B (root V), DOC-1 A/E-net, NEW-7 E-net. All four data findings reaching strict sit in the host-site / host-policy decisions the library re-derives (class B/A).
notes: Result: not clean (4 data findings reach strict). ISO-1 (same-site refusal fails open when the cookie probe cannot write) and ISO-2 (location.origin is 'null' in a srcdoc host) are incomplete fixes of BD2:ISO-2/NEW-2; CHL-1 is a new shared-state race in the host-policy read. Verifier V3 could not confirm that Osano/Cookiebot wrap the cookie setter. Not archived: LIM-1, DOC, TST, NEW findings have no verifier verdict.
